text: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc., a holding company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, owns the national bank PNC Bank, National Association.

source.name: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc.: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: We primarily conduct our business through our primary domestic bank subsidiary, PNC Bank, a national banking association chartered and located in Wilmington, Delaware.

additionalSources.name: Federal Reserve Board: Order approving the merger of The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. with FirstBank Holding Company (FRB Order No. 2025-22)
additionalSources.quote: merge FirstBank with and into PNC’s subsidiary national bank, PNC Bank, National Association (“PNC Bank”), Wilmington, Delaware.
